name: Bowen Basin Wireless
summary: Wireless ISP for QLD coal country (Digital Signal Solutions; Emerald, Mackay, Moranbah, Dysart, ~2008); defunct.

events.details: Digital Signal Solutions — Bowen Basin Wireless: wireless broadband + hotspots (plans/rates, coverage). Earliest bowenbasin.com.au capture 29 Aug 2008.

Retail site captured live in 2008; bowenbasin.com.au had degraded to an empty web-server directory listing ('Index of /') by Apr 2013, i.e. defunct between 2008 and 2013. Domain later reused (unrelated 'Bowen Basin Sun Farm' by 2024).
